customer_message.subject: chat – termination Bergstrasse 39
customer_message.body:
Ibrahim Volkov: hi. got the termination letter from Wohnwerk Thur on Monday, my flat at Bergstrasse 39 in Brugg, 2.5 rooms. they want me out by 30 April 2027
Ibrahim Volkov: they say it's because of unpaid rent. yes I owe them three months, CHF 4380, I had a bad year
Ibrahim Volkov: but honestly I think the main reason is that I complained to the building authority about the mould in the basement storage and they had to pay for a renovation. right after that they started sending reminders. it's revenge
Ibrahim Volkov: I attached the first page of my lease
Ibrahim Volkov: can I fight this? how long do I have?
